summary.text: Ric Metzgar is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 6 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

The district elects three delegates, and he is on the November ballot with fellow Republican incumbents Robin Grammer and Bob Long and Democrats Artus Huffman, Megan Ann Mioduszewski and Rayneika Rob.
A former general manager of G and W Motors, he serves on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ric Metzgar was born in Essex, Maryland, and graduated from Kenwood High School.

According to his legislative biography, he earned a certificate in clinical pastoral education from Northwest Bible College in Minot, North Dakota, and attended the Community College of Baltimore County.
Metzgar was general manager of G and W Motors, Inc. from 1989 to 2015.
Ballotpedia says Metzgar assumed office on January 14, 2015.
The General Assembly website lists him as a member of the Appropriations Committee.
